business_summary.text: Omnitech Engineering is a precision engineering and contract manufacturing company serving energy, motion control and automation, and industrial equipment customers, with about 78% of Q1FY27 revenue from exports.

call_points.text: EBITDA margin guided at 30% and above, similar to historical levels.
Gross margin expected at 68-71%, against around 70% now.
Two new Chhapara facilities to start in FY28; capex has a slight spillover into FY28.
Existing plants can support roughly ₹800-900 Cr of revenue; new capex adds similar capacity in a staggered way.
Energy was 49% of Q1FY27 revenue, motion control 24%, industrial equipment 19% and others 7%.
Total debt ₹390 Cr after repaying ₹50 Cr from IPO proceeds; NBFC loans restructured for lower interest.
Defence and aerospace revenue is small and booked under 'others'; meaningful contribution expected over 1-3 years.
Depreciation method changed from written down value to straight line from this year.
FY27 revenue growth guided at 30-35%, in line with the last four to five years.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 30-35%, similar to historical levels.
Order book mix: Energy 74%, Motion and Automation 14%, Industrial Equipment 12%.
Three FY27 initiatives: new Hyderabad facility, Chhapara expansion, and solar roofing at Chhapara.
Q4 gross margin fell about 450 bps against the prior two quarters; management expects margins to revert to historical levels.
Net debt-to-equity improved to 0.34x in FY26 from 1.6x in FY25.
Management declined to quantify the oil and gas addressable market, citing lack of official data.
Weatherford contract EBITDA margin not disclosed; management cited confidentiality.
Revenue mix FY26: Energy 53%, Motion control and automation 25%, Industrial equipment 16%, others 6%.
Geographic mix FY26: North America 53%, India 24%, Asia 19%, Europe and UK 4%.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected at 30-35%, in line with the last four to five years.
Capex of ₹250 Cr at Chhapara, with slight spillover into FY28

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Manufacturing > Industrial Products

operating_notes.text: Monitoring agency report by CRISIL shows ₹135.45 Cr utilized in Q4 FY26 out of ₹391.74 Cr net IPO proceeds.
FY26 inventories ₹314.54 Cr and trade receivables ₹213.8 Cr absorbed ₹241.43 Cr of working capital, leaving operating cash flow at -₹1.98 Cr.
IPO net proceeds ₹391.74 Cr; ₹116.77 Cr utilised to 31 March 2026, ₹274.97 Cr unutilised.
Order book as of May 25, 2026 exceeds ₹3,033 Cr.
Order book as on 25 May 2026 exceeds ₹3,000 Cr, including the multi-year Weatherford order of more than ₹900 Cr.
Existing capacity is 2.6 million machine hours, rising above 4 million with new capacity; precision capability up to 5 microns.
Receivable days at 153 and payable days at 80 in FY26; working capital at ₹294 Cr.
Order book of over ₹3,000 Cr as on July 31, 2026 includes ₹2,000 Cr from two orders with 4-5 year timelines and ₹1,000 Cr of short-to-moderate cycle orders to be executed in 6-18 months.
Annualised installed machine capacity was 3.2 million hours as on June 30, 2026, up about 20.7% from FY26, across three plants.
About 78% of Q1FY27 revenue came from exports, with North America at 52%, Asia 27%, India 17% and Europe/UK 3%.
Commenced receiving commercial orders for data centre infrastructure value chain following First Article approval.
Secured commercial orders from leading Indian defence-sector organisations for land-based systems and advanced sub-systems applications.

holders.name: NIPPON LIFE INDIA TRUSTEE LTD-A/C NIPPON POWER & INFRA FUND

timeline.summary: On May 13, 2026, Omnitech Engineering released the CRISIL Ratings Monitoring Agency Report for IPO proceeds utilization for Q4 FY26.
On May 19, 2026, Omnitech Engineering announced an upgrade in its credit ratings by Infomerics to IVR A/Stable for long-term and IVR A1 for short-term facilities.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹148.72 Cr, net profit ₹29.33 Cr.
On May 27, 2026, Omnitech Engineering released its investor presentation for Q4FY26 and FY26, reporting ₹511.3 Cr revenue and ₹79.34 Cr PAT.
Omnitech Engineering Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4-FY26 earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, available via its website.

On May 29, 2026, Omnitech Engineering filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, where management guided FY27 revenue growth at 30-35% and EBITDA margin at 30-35% on a ₹3,000 Cr order book.
Udaykumar Arunkumar Parekh (Promoter) declared nil new substantial shareholding under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 on April 01, 2026.
On August 7, 2026, Omnitech Engineering held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting revenue of ₹166.6 Cr (+61.5% YoY) and an order book above ₹3,000 Cr.
Omnitech Engineering announced commercial orders in the data centre infrastructure value chain on October 21, 2026.
Omnitech Engineering secured commercial orders from Indian defence-sector organisations for precision-engineered components on October 21, 2026.
